Description: 1x7 female socket header 2.54 mm, 8.5 mm tall (XIAO)

Description: Tactile switch 6 mm, through hole (the one button)
Slide switch SPDT, E-Switch EG1218 (battery on/off)

Description: 0 ohm resistor 0603
Notes: Links D4 to the display backlight pin. Without it the backlight is always full brightness.

Description: Test pads (part of the PCB, nothing to buy)

Description: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 (not the Sense version), with 2 x 7 male pins soldered on

Description: 18-pin 0.5 mm pitch FFC cable (display to breakout)
Notes: Check the contacts face the right way at both ends (see docs/assembly.md).

Description: LiPo 3.7 V 1000 mAh, 503450 (about 5 x 34 x 50 mm), JST PH 2.0 mm plug
